**Depends on:** P0-04; independent of physical hardware

**Depends on:** P0-02 and P0-03; can run alongside Phase 1

**Responsible roles:** Backend/device integration
**Depends on:** P2-05

**Responsible roles:** Mobile
**Depends on:** P1-03, P1-05 and Phase 3

**Depends on:** Phase 4; command/configuration APIs available

milestones.name: Phase 6 — Complete History and Device management
milestones.description:
**Responsible roles:** Mobile + backend integration
**Depends on:** Phase 5
**Exit gate:** Users can audit outcomes and manage multiple devices without losing scope or exposing secrets.

milestones.name: Phase 7 — Harden integration and prepare hardware handoff

**Depends on:** Phase 6

**Responsible roles:** Product + mobile + backend + hardware
**Depends on:** P7-04 and P8-06
